name: legacy_text_only
why: A row written before parts existed: content and a timestamp, nothing else. Both languages must mint the SAME synthetic turn id, or one stored message can occupy two entries in the client's turn registry (invariant U01).

known_divergences.cause: turn_document.py:legacy_turn_id uses sha256[:16]; turn_document.js:legacyTurnId uses a 32-bit string hash. Two implementations of one identity function.
known_divergences.impact: Only reachable on a path where the server did not hydrate the row first (sse_chat/__init__.py:1711 does hydrate the /messages route). Where it is reachable, one stored message can be bound under two turn ids.
